findings.evidence: Lines 177, 187, and 201 all take an explicit basis; Mathlib provides `Module.Free.of_basis (b : Basis κ R M) : Module.Free R M`.
findings.fix: Remove the freeness parameter from this basis-coordinate API, installing `Module.Free.of_basis b` locally if needed; decouple `ComplexTorus`/`IntegralCharacter` from their unused finite-free parameters if necessary.
findings.issue: `Module.Basis.complexTorusCoordinates` and both companion lemmas require `[Module.Free ℤ N]`, although `b : Basis κ ℤ N` already proves this.

findings.evidence: `IsIntegralLattice` in `Algebraic/Lattice.lean` has fields `free : Module.Free ℤ N` and `finite : Module.Finite ℤ N`; the redundant assumptions affect declarations at lines 71–152.
findings.fix: Drop both section-level typeclasses and install `hi.free` and `hi.finite` locally (adjusting the unnecessarily constrained `ComplexTorus` abbreviation as needed).
findings.issue: Every theorem in this file inherits `[Module.Free ℤ N] [Module.Finite ℤ N]` even though `hi : IsIntegralLattice i` contains exactly those witnesses as `hi.free` and `hi.finite`; callers must redundantly supply instances.

summary: The new basis and cone-action APIs retain redundant freeness assumptions already supplied by their explicit data.
